en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 16.27.
Vipākattika, Hetuduka
Dependent on a resultant, root-conditioned state, a non-resultant, non-root state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a resultant, root-conditioned state, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-possessing-the-nature-of-resultant and a non-root state arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a resultant, root-conditioned state, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-possessing-the-nature-of-resultant and a non-root state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a resultant (vipāka) causal state, there arise states that are neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant and not-causal, by way of the root condition (hetupaccaya).

Dependent on a resultant causal state, there arise states that are non-resultant and not-causal, and states that are neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant and not-causal, by way of the root condition... [five].
Dependent on a state that is a cause and has the nature of ripening, a state that is not a cause and does not have the nature of ripening arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is a cause and has the nature of ripening, a state that is neither ripening nor a cause arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is a cause and has the nature of ripening, a state that is neither ripening nor having the nature of ripening [arises]...

A non-root phenomenon arises conditioned by a root cause. Dependent on a non-resultant, non-root phenomenon that is neither-result-nor-result-of-matter, there arise non-resultant, non-root phenomena and non-resultant, non-root phenomena that are neither-result-nor-result-of-matter, conditioned by a root cause.
… three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root condition (hetu), there are thirteen; in the case of object condition (ārammaṇa), nine ... pe ... in the case of mutuality condition (aññamañña), eleven ... pe ... in the case of repetition condition (āsevana), six ... pe ... in the case of resultant condition (vipāka), five ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition (avigata), there are thirteen.
Dependent on a resultant state that is not a root, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant and is not a root arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a resultant state that is not a root, a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant and is not a root [arises].

[They] arise by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Dependent on a resultant state that is not a root-cause (*nahetu*), there arise states that are neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant and not root-causes, by way of root condition... [three].
Dependent on a state of the nature of result and not a root-cause, there arises a state that is neither-resultant nor of the nature of resultant and not a root-cause, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is of the nature to ripen (vipākadhammadhamma) and is not a cause (nahetu),

there arises a state that is neither-ripening-nor-of-the-nature-to-ripen (naneva-vipāka-navipākadhammadhamma) and is not a cause, by way of the root-condition (hetupaccaya). Dependent on a state that is of the nature to ripen and is not a cause,
there arise states that are neither-ripening [nor-of-the-nature-to-ripen] and are not causes, by way of the root-condition… three.

Dependent on a state that is neither result nor of the nature to produce result and is not a root, there arises a state that is neither result nor of the nature to produce result and is not a root, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither result nor of the nature to produce result and is not a root, there arises a state that is not a result and is not a root, by way of root-condition …pe…. [Dependent on] a state that is neither result nor of the nature to produce result … [and so forth].

Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor resultant, and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-to-arise-as-a-resultant and not-root, there arise states that are neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-to-arise-as-a-resultant and not-root, by way of root-condition … five.

Dependent on a resultant state that is not-root, and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-to-arise-as-a-resultant and not-root, there arises a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-to-arise-as-a-resultant and not-root, by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated.)
